about: Developer debug UIs left in SLUS_216.21 (Atlus's event editor mt_evtMenu.c, the ksk list boxes of k_lbox.c, the field editor's NPC placement boxes, the effect editor, the debug print layer) turned into field metadata for the editor's Inspector. Labels are the developers' own strings, read from the ELF at label_addr (quoted as evidence); names are our proposals (ADR-0009). Offsets cite a readable body (src + fn), a header line (src + match) or, for the three functions without a readable body, the ELF (elf_fn); tools/ours/debug_ui/check_debug_fields.py checks them. docs/ANALYSIS/30_debug_tools.md explains the tools.

conventions.type: u8 s8 u16 s16 u32 s32 f32 ptr, char[n], u8[n]
conventions.min / max: the editor's clamp or wrap range (inclusive); see unit for floats shown in other units
conventions.wrap: true: the value wraps past min / max
conventions.enum: values -> developer label (addr = pointer table, addrs = string addresses)
conventions.subfields: bit ranges of a packed field
conventions.menu: evt:<id> = event-editor menu of 0x6A0270, lbox:<table> = ksk list box descriptor table
conventions.variants: EvtKey parameter block per unit type (EvtUnit+0) and sub-command (EvtKey+16); a variant 'X/Y' extends 'X', and every variant extends the record's common fields
conventions.evidence: {fn, src}: a readable body accessing the offset; {src, match}: a header line; {elf_fn}: the function's instructions in the ELF

EvtKey.doc: one key of an event unit (84 B; events.h evt::key). +16..+55 is a per-unit-type parameter block: the variants below are selected by the owning unit's type (EvtUnit+0, names at 0x69F1B0) and, where given, by the sub-command byte +16. Labels are the event editor's (mt_evtMenu.c) column titles 0x69E100, choice-list titles and menu row strings.
